review.material: The complete publisher-deposited abstract and official publication record were read.
review.limitations: The three-page argument and examples were inaccessible.

evidence.description: The abstract states the role of identity rules.

sections.title: What it is about
sections.text: The note concerns identity rules A → A: rules whose two sides are the same shape.

sections.title: Central claim
sections.text: Stiny’s abstract says an identity can restructure a shape while leaving the shape itself unchanged. Geometric output and the structure recognized in it are distinguished.

sections.title: What remains to be read
sections.text: The abstract states the idea but does not give the note’s formal account or worked diagrams. These cannot be reconstructed responsibly from the title alone.

sections.title: Reading boundary
sections.text: No full-text definitions, proof or examples were inspected. The title is not a claim that identities have no perceptual role.

sections.title: A small reading prompt
sections.text: Look at an unchanged drawing in two different ways and record the parts you recognize each time. This is a suggested exploration of the distinction, not an example attributed to the paper.

terms.meaning: A rule A → A, with identical left and right shapes.
